note: TWO NUMBERS, NOT ONE (ASK-285). `cap` is the gate; `total_always_on` is the last observed total; `files` is the per-file snapshot that lets a drop be classified. A drop from SCOPING (a rule moved to paths-scoped, every line still on disk) holds the cap and banks the freed lines as headroom an append may spend. A drop from DELETION (lines left the tree) lowers the cap permanently. cap moves only by -deletion_delta, so the floor may tighten and never loosen. This replaces the single auto-tightening number that deadlocked against apply_claude_changes.py, which can express neither a removal nor a scoping: every rule-file append was unlandable. The ASK-136 +1 bump this file used to carry was the symptom of that deadlock; the mechanism is now the fix. Target remains 300. An AGENT cannot bank headroom (scoping is a frontmatter edit the engine refuses); the founder can, an agent spends it.
